answer: Here is one concrete wall: Proof of unique board-game league record. It works because a league record with weekly results for two years, and the inlet it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Honest agents already carry what Proof of unique board-game league record asks for, so they pass without noticing; the nadir is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The karst is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
